createSession reads the booking snapshot and inserts with no post-insert status re-check, so handleBookingCompleted's conditional UPDATE (0 rows, debug-logged) can run before the INSERT commits, and updateSession's terminal-booking SESSION_PLAN_LOCKED guard then strands the DRAFT plan permanently.
